svg.aria-label: The four staff archetypes placed by organisation size and by how wide their scope is. Tech lead sits at small organisations with one team cluster. Solver sits at mid size with a roving narrow scope. Architect needs a large organisation and owns a domain. Right hand only exists at very large organisations and takes the widest scope.
svg.text: THE ARCHETYPE IS CHOSEN BY THE ORGANISATION, NOT BY YOU
